admission.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria (DSE)
bullets: Minimum DSE requirement: **Best 6 subjects at 32 points** (median entry score). Pharmacy is highly competitive; successful entrants typically score **30-34 points**.

Core subject minimums: **Level 3 in Chinese Language and English Language**; **Level 2 in Mathematics (Compulsory Part) and Liberal Studies** (or Citizenship and Social Development). **English at Level 4+ strongly preferred** for reading scientific literature.

Elective requirements: **Chemistry at Level 4+ is strongly preferred**. **Biology at Level 4+ is highly recommended**. Physics or Combined Science (Chemistry + Biology) also accepted. M1/M2 Mathematics is helpful for pharmacokinetics and biostatistics.
**No JUPAS interview** for standard admission. Selection is based on academic merit and OEA/SLP. Non-JUPAS applicants may be invited to an interview.
Subject weightings: **Chemistry and Biology receive 1.5x weighting** in admission scoring. English Language at standard weighting. Bonus points for Level 5** in Chemistry or Biology.

curriculum.title: Programme Structure & Curriculum
bullets: **4-year full-time programme** (240 credits). Accredited by the **Pharmacy and Poisons Board of Hong Kong (PPBHK)** - graduates are eligible for **Registered Pharmacist (Part A)** registration.

**Year 1**: Foundation sciences - **General Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Human Physiology, and Biochemistry**. Students also complete **University Common Core** courses and a **pharmacy orientation** module.

**Year 2**: Core pharmacy sciences - **Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology, Medicinal Chemistry, and Pharmacognosy**. Introduction to **pharmacy practice** and **dispensing skills** in the faculty simulation laboratory.

**Year 3**: Clinical and applied pharmacy - **Therapeutics, Clinical Pharmacokinetics, Pharmaceutical Care, and Pharmacy Management**. Students begin **hospital and community pharmacy placements** (total 400+ hours).

**Year 4**: Advanced practice and capstone - **Advanced Therapeutics, Pharmacoeconomics, Drug Information, and Research Project**. Extended **clinical rotations** in **Queen Mary Hospital, Prince of Wales Hospital, and community pharmacy chains** (e.g., Watsons, Mannings).

**Professional accreditation**: Full accreditation by **PPBHK** and recognition by **Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS, UK)**. Graduates may sit the **Registration Examination** to become registered pharmacists in Hong Kong.

**Research opportunities**: Students may join research projects in **drug delivery, pharmacogenomics, clinical pharmacy, and traditional Chinese medicine-pharmaceutical interactions**. HKU has active collaborations with **Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT)**.

career.title: Career Pathways & Prospects
bullets: **Hospital pharmacy**: Graduates join **Hospital Authority** as **Resident Pharmacists** at **Queen Mary Hospital, Prince of Wales Hospital, Queen Elizabeth Hospital, and Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital**. Starting salary: **HK4,060/month** (Point 15). Progression to **Senior Pharmacist** at **HK4,220/month** (Point 27).

**Community pharmacy**: Roles at **Watsons, Mannings, Guardian, and independent pharmacies** as **Registered Pharmacists** and **Pharmacy Managers**. Starting salary: **HK8,000-35,000/month**. Store managers earn **HK0,000-55,000/month**.

**Pharmaceutical industry**: **Drug safety, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, and clinical research** roles at **Pfizer, Roche, GSK, AstraZeneca, and local biotech firms** (e.g., **Sino Biopharmaceutical, Innovent Biologics**). Starting salaries: **HK5,000-32,000/month**.

**Government and regulatory**: **Department of Health** roles in **drug registration, pharmacy inspection, and poison control**. **Pharmacy and Poisons Board** administrative roles. Starting salaries: **HK2,000-34,000/month** depending on grade.

**Further studies**: **Master of Pharmacy (MPharm)** for specialisation (UK/Australia). **MSc in Clinical Pharmacy** or **Pharmaceutical Sciences** for research or advanced practice. **PhD** for academic and pharmaceutical R&D careers.

**Entrepreneurship**: Some graduates open **independent pharmacies** or join **pharmacy chains** in management. The **pharmaceutical e-commerce** sector (e.g., **HKTVmall pharmacy, Ztore**) is growing rapidly.

campus.title: Campus Life & Student Experience
bullets: **Faculty of Medicine Building (21 Sassoon Road)**: Houses **pharmacy teaching laboratories, dispensing simulation rooms, and research facilities**. The **Medicine Common Room** is a hub for inter-professional student activities.

**HKU Pharmacy Society**: Active student society organising **drug information workshops, community health screenings, and industry visits** to pharmaceutical companies and hospitals. Annual **Pharmacy Night** networking dinner with alumni.

**Dispensing laboratory**: State-of-the-art **simulation pharmacy** where students practice **prescription dispensing, patient counselling, and compounding** under supervision. Equipped with **electronic prescribing systems** used in Hospital Authority.

**Inter-professional education (IPE)**: Pharmacy students collaborate with **Medicine, Nursing, and Dentistry** students on **case-based learning** and **simulated ward rounds** - preparing for real healthcare team dynamics.

**Location**: Faculty is at **Sassoon Road, Pok Fu Lam** - a 10-minute shuttle bus from Main Campus. Students have access to **both Main Campus facilities** (libraries, halls, sports) and **Medical Campus resources** (hospital libraries, clinical skills labs).

competitiveness.title: Admission Competitiveness Analysis
bullets: **Overall difficulty: ★★★★☆ Highly Competitive** - HKU Pharmacy is one of the most competitive health sciences programmes. The small cohort size and high demand create intense competition.
**Median DSE score: 32 points** (Best 6). Lower quartile typically scores **30-31 points**. Upper quartile reaches **33-34 points**. Chemistry and Biology grades are critical.
**Band A applicants vs places**: Approximately **6-8 Band A applicants per place**. Total JUPAS intake: **~40-50 students** per year (one of the smallest cohorts at HKU).

**Non-JUPAS intake**: Around **10-15%** of places for international qualifications. IB entrants typically present **36-38 points** with HL Chemistry and Biology. A-Level candidates need **AAA** including Chemistry and Biology.

**Comparison with CUHK Pharmacy (JS4501)**: HKU Pharmacy has **stronger hospital pharmacy links** (Queen Mary Hospital is the teaching hospital) and more research opportunities in **pharmaceutical sciences**. CUHK Pharmacy has a **larger cohort** and stronger **community pharmacy** training. Median scores are comparable (CUHK ~31-32).

**Key differentiators for successful applicants**: (1) **Chemistry and Biology at Level 5***; (2) **Strong English** for scientific reading; (3) **Healthcare volunteering** - hospital auxiliary, pharmacy shadowing, elderly care; (4) **Scientific curiosity** demonstrated in SLP - science competitions, research projects, or health innovation initiatives.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Faculty
bullets: **Prof. Vincent Lee Hoi-ying** - Former Head of Pharmacy at HKU and leading researcher in **clinical pharmacokinetics and personalised medicine**. His work on **warfarin dosing algorithms** has improved patient safety across Hong Kong hospitals.

**Dr. William Chui Chun-ming** - President of the **Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Hong Kong** and former Chief Pharmacist at **Queen Mary Hospital**. HKU BPharm and MClinPharm. Advocate for **clinical pharmacy services expansion** in public hospitals.

**Ms. Bonnie Leung** - Former Director of Pharmacy at **Watsons Hong Kong** and industry leader in **community pharmacy practice**. HKU BPharm. Pioneered **pharmacist-led health screening services** in retail pharmacies.

**Prof. Li Jun** - Chair Professor of Pharmaceutics at HKU and expert in **nanomedicine and targeted drug delivery**. His research on **cancer nanotherapeutics** has led to multiple patents and spin-off companies.

**Dr. Esther Chan** - Clinical Professor and specialist in **geriatric pharmacy**. Her research on **polypharmacy in elderly patients** has influenced Hospital Authority prescribing guidelines. Recipient of the **Faculty Teaching Excellence Award**.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
bullets: **HKU Foundation Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to top JUPAS entrants with **Best 6 at 35 points or above**. Covers **full tuition fees** (HK$42,100/year) plus living allowance of **HK$15,000/year**. Renewable with CGPA 3.00+.

**Faculty of Medicine Scholarships**: Merit-based awards for continuing students with **CGPA 3.50+**. Amounts range from **HK$10,000 to HK$25,000** per year. Pharmacy-specific awards funded by **pharmaceutical companies** (e.g., Pfizer, Roche) and alumni.

**Pharmacy and Poisons Board Scholarship**: For outstanding pharmacy students demonstrating **academic excellence and commitment to the profession**. **HK$20,000/year**. Includes mentorship from **senior registered pharmacists**.

**Hospital Authority Pharmacy Scholarship**: For students interested in **hospital pharmacy careers**. Covers **tuition fees** and provides **guaranteed pre-registration placement** at a Hospital Authority hospital. Requires **2-year service commitment** post-registration.

**HKU Bursaries and Financial Aid**: Need-based support through **SFAA** and HKU bursary fund. Covers tuition, hall fees, and living expenses. **Pharmacy-specific emergency grants** available for students facing hardship during clinical placements.

tips.title: Ace Sir's Pharmacy Strategy
bullets: **Ace Sir says: Pharmacy is the most underrated high-paying health career.** At 32 points median, it is more accessible than Medicine (39) but offers **excellent job security** and **starting salaries of HK$34,000/month** in hospitals. The small cohort means **personal attention** from professors.

**Subject combination strategy**: **Chemistry + Biology is essential**. If you have **M1/M2**, it helps with pharmacokinetics calculations. Physics is less critical but acceptable as a third elective. **English at Level 4+** is important for reading drug monographs and clinical guidelines.

**Band A positioning**: Put JS6492 in **Band A if your Best 6 is 30+ with Chemistry and Biology at Level 5***. If your score is 28-29, it is a **reach** - but strong science grades can compensate. Have CUHK Pharmacy (JS4501) or PolyU Optometry in Band B.

**Get pharmacy exposure early**: Unlike Medicine, pharmacy is less understood by students. **Shadow a pharmacist** at Watsons, Mannings, or a hospital outpatient pharmacy. Mention this in your SLP - admissions officers value **informed career choice**.

**Do not confuse Pharmacy with Pharmaceutical Sciences**: HKU BPharm is a **professional degree** leading to pharmacist registration. If you want **drug research and development** without clinical practice, consider **BSc in Biomedical Sciences** or **BSc in Chemistry** instead.

admission.title: 入學資格與收生要求（DSE）
bullets: 最低 DSE 要求：**最佳六科達 32 分**（中位數入學成績）。藥劑學競爭激烈；成功入學者通常考獲 **30-34 分**
核心科目最低要求：**中國語文及英國語文達第 3 級**；**數學（必修部分）及通識教育**（或公民與社會發展）達第 2 級。**英國語文達第 4 級以上強烈偏好**，以應對科學文獻閱讀
選修科要求：**化學達第 4 級以上強烈偏好**。**生物達第 4 級以上高度建議**。物理或組合科學（化學+生物）亦獲接受。M1/M2 數學對藥物動力學及生物統計學有幫助
標準 JUPAS 入學**不設面試**。篩選基於學業成績及 OEA/SLP。非 JUPAS 申請人或獲邀參加面試
科目比重：**化學及生物於入學分數計算中獲 1.5 倍比重**。英國語文按標準比重計算。化學或生物考獲 5** 可獲額外加分

curriculum.title: 課程結構與內容
bullets: **四年全日制課程**（240 學分）。獲**香港藥劑業及毒藥管理局（PPBHK）**認可——畢業生符合資格申請**註冊藥劑師（第一部）**註冊
**第一年**：基礎科學——**普通化學、有機化學、人體生理學及生物化學**。學生同時完成**大學共同核心課程**及**藥劑學導論**單元
**第二年**：核心藥劑科學——**藥劑學、藥理學、藥物化學及生藥學**。於學院模擬實驗室開始學習**藥劑實務**及**配藥技能**
**第三年**：臨床及應用藥劑學——**治療學、臨床藥物動力學、藥學照護及藥房管理**。學生開始**醫院及社區藥房實習**（總計超過 400 小時）
**第四年**：進階實務及畢業專題——**進階治療學、藥物經濟學、藥物資訊及研究項目**。於**瑪麗醫院、威爾斯親王醫院及社區藥房連鎖店**（如屈臣氏、萬寧）進行**臨床輪轉實習**
**專業認可**：獲**PPBHK**全面認可及**英國皇家藥劑學會（RPS）**承認。畢業生可參加**註冊考試**成為香港註冊藥劑師
**研究機會**：學生可參與**藥物傳遞、藥物基因組學、臨床藥劑學及中藥與西藥相互作用**等研究項目。港大與**深圳先進技術研究院（SIAT）**有密切合作

career.title: 職業出路與前景
bullets: **醫院藥劑部**：畢業生加入**醫院管理局**擔任**駐院藥劑師**，於**瑪麗醫院、威爾斯親王醫院、伊利沙伯醫院及東區尤德夫人那打素醫院**工作。起薪點：**每月 34,060 港元**（第 15 點）。晉升至**高級藥劑師**達**每月 54,220 港元**（第 27 點）
**社區藥房**：於**屈臣氏、萬寧、Guardian 及獨立藥房**擔任**註冊藥劑師**及**藥房經理**。起薪點：**每月 28,000-35,000 港元**。店舖經理收入達**每月 40,000-55,000 港元**
**製藥工業**：於**輝瑞、羅氏、葛蘭素史克、阿斯利康及本地生物科技公司**（如**中國生物製藥、信達生物**）擔任**藥物安全、法規事務、醫學事務及臨床研究**職位。起薪點：**每月 25,000-32,000 港元**
**政府及監管機構**：**衞生署**的**藥物註冊、藥房巡查及毒藥管制**職位。**藥劑業及毒藥管理局**行政職位。起薪點：**每月 22,000-34,000 港元**（視職級而定）
**進修途徑**：修讀**藥劑學碩士（MPharm）**以專業進修（英國／澳洲）。修讀**臨床藥劑學理學碩士**或**藥物科學理學碩士**以從事研究或進階實務。攻讀**博士學位**從事學術及藥物研發事業
**創業**：部分畢業生開設**獨立藥房**或加入**藥房連鎖店**管理層。**藥物電子商務**界別（如**HKTVmall 藥房、士多**）正快速增長

campus.title: 校園生活與學生體驗
bullets: **醫學院大樓（沙宣道 21 號）**：設有**藥劑學教學實驗室、配藥模擬室及研究設施**。**醫學院公共休息室**是跨專業學生活動的中心
**港大藥劑學會**：活躍的學生學會，舉辦**藥物資訊工作坊、社區健康篩查及業界參觀**（參觀製藥公司及醫院）。每年舉辦**藥劑之夜**校友聯誼晚宴
**配藥實驗室**：最先進的**模擬藥房**，學生在督導下練習**處方配藥、病人諮詢及藥物調配**。配備醫院管理局使用的**電子處方系統**
**跨專業教育（IPE）**：藥劑學學生與**醫學、護理及牙科**學生合作進行**病例為本學習**及**模擬病房巡房**——為真實醫療團隊協作做好準備
**地理位置**：學院位於**薄扶林沙宣道**——距離本部校園 10 分鐘穿梭巴士車程。學生可使用**本部校園設施**（圖書館、舍堂、體育設施）及**醫學院校園資源**（醫院圖書館、臨床技能實驗室）

competitiveness.title: 入學競爭力分析
bullets: **整體難度：★★★★☆ 高度競爭**——港大藥劑學是最具競爭力的健康科學課程之一。小班教學及高需求造成激烈競爭
**中位數 DSE 成績：32 分**（最佳六科）。下四分位數通常考獲 **30-31 分**。上四分位數達 **33-34 分**。化學及生物成績至關重要
**Band A 申請人與學額比例**：每個學額約有 **6-8 個 Band A 申請人**。JUPAS 總收生額：每年約 **40-50 人**（港大最小班之一）
**非 JUPAS 入學比例**：約 **10-15%** 學額保留予國際學歷申請人。IB 入學者通常考獲 **36-38 分**並修讀高級程度化學及生物。A-Level 考生需考獲 **AAA**（包括化學及生物）
**與中大藥劑學（JS4501）比較**：港大藥劑學擁有**更強的醫院藥劑聯繫**（瑪麗醫院為教學醫院）及更多**藥物科學**研究機會。中大藥劑學**班級較大**及**社區藥房**培訓更強。中位數成績相若（中大約 31-32 分）
**成功申請人的關鍵優勢**：(1) **化學及生物達第 5 級**；(2) **優異的英語能力**以應對科學閱讀；(3) **醫療義工經驗**——醫院輔助醫療服務、藥房見習、長者護理；(4) 於 SLP 中展現**科學好奇心**——科學比賽、研究項目或健康創新計劃

alumni.title: 知名校友與師資
bullets: **李海鷹教授**——前港大藥劑學系主任及**臨床藥物動力學與個人化醫療**領域的領先研究者。其**華法林劑量演算法**研究提升了全港醫院的病人安全
**崔俊明博士**——前**香港醫院藥劑師學會會長**及前**瑪麗醫院首席藥劑師**。港大藥劑學學士及臨床藥劑學碩士。倡議擴展公立醫院**臨床藥劑服務**
**梁女士**——前**屈臣氏香港藥劑部總監**及**社區藥房實務**業界領袖。港大藥劑學學士。開創零售藥房**藥劑師主導健康篩查服務**
**李峻教授**——港大藥劑學講座教授及**納米醫學與標靶藥物傳遞**專家。其**癌症納米治療**研究獲得多項專利並衍生多家初創企業
**陳教授**——臨床教授及**老年藥劑學**專家。其關於**長者多重用藥**的研究影響了醫院管理局的處方指引。獲頒**學院教學卓越獎**

scholarships.title: 獎學金與經濟援助
bullets: **港大基金入學獎學金**：頒予最佳六科達 **35 分或以上**的頂尖 JUPAS 入學者。涵蓋**全額學費**（每年 42,100 港元）加生活津貼**每年 15,000 港元**。CGPA 達 3.00+ 可續領
**醫學院獎學金**：頒予**CGPA 達 3.50+**的在讀學生。金額由**每年 10,000 至 25,000 港元**不等。藥劑學專屬獎項由**製藥公司**（如輝瑞、羅氏）及校友資助
**藥劑業及毒藥管理局獎學金**：頒予表現傑出並**致力投身藥劑專業**的藥劑學學生。**每年 20,000 港元**。包括**資深註冊藥劑師**導師指導
**醫院管理局藥劑學獎學金**：供有志從事**醫院藥劑事業**的學生申請。涵蓋**學費**並提供**醫院管理局醫院保證實習安排**。註冊後須**服務兩年**
**港大助學金及經濟援助**：透過**在職家庭及學生資助事務處**及港大助學基金提供按需要資助。涵蓋學費、舍堂費及生活費。**藥劑學專屬緊急援助金**供臨床實習期間面臨困難的學生申請

tips.title: Ace Sir 的藥劑學攻略
bullets: **Ace Sir 說：藥劑學是最被低估的高薪醫療事業。**中位數 32 分，比醫學（39 分）更易入讀，但提供**極佳的就業保障**及**醫院起薪點每月 34,000 港元**。小班教學意味教授可給予**個人化指導**
**選科策略**：**化學 + 生物為必需**。如有**M1/M2**，對藥物動力學計算有幫助。物理重要性較低但可作為第三選修科。**英國語文達第 4 級以上**對閱讀藥物專論及臨床指引很重要
**Band A 定位**：如最佳六科達 **30 分以上且化學及生物達第 5 級**，將 JS6492 放於**Band A**。如成績為 28-29 分，屬**衝刺選擇**——但優異的理科成績可彌補。於 Band B 放置中大藥劑學（JS4501）或理大視光學
**及早接觸藥劑學**：與醫學不同，學生對藥劑學認識較少。**到屈臣氏、萬寧或醫院門診藥房見習藥劑師**。於 SLP 中提及——招生官重視**有根據的職業選擇**
**勿混淆藥劑學與藥物科學**：港大藥劑學學士是**專業學位**，可註冊成為藥劑師。如希望從事**藥物研發**而無須臨床實務，可考慮**生物醫學理學士**或**化學理學士**

admission.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria (DSE)
bullets: Minimum DSE requirement: **Best 6 subjects at 27 points** (median entry score). The Faculty of Social Sciences admits a broad range of candidates; successful entrants typically score **25-29 points**.

Core subject minimums: **Level 3 in Chinese Language and English Language**; **Level 2 in Mathematics (Compulsory Part) and Liberal Studies** (or Citizenship and Social Development). **English at Level 4+ strongly preferred** for majors like Journalism, International Relations, and Social Work.

Elective requirements: **No specific elective requirements**. The Faculty welcomes diverse subject combinations. However, **Economics, History, or Geography** may be advantageous for related majors. M1/M2 Mathematics is helpful for Economics, Psychology (statistics), and Social Data Science.

**No JUPAS interview** for standard admission. Selection is based on academic merit and OEA/SLP. Non-JUPAS applicants may be invited to an interview for competitive majors (e.g., Journalism, Social Work, Psychology).
Subject weightings: **Chinese Language and English Language receive 1.5x weighting**. Mathematics and Liberal Studies at standard weighting. Bonus points for Level 5** in any subject.

curriculum.title: Programme Structure & Curriculum
bullets: **4-year full-time programme** (240 credits). Students select a **major** from **9 departments** and may add a **minor** from Social Sciences or other faculties. Double majors available with approval.

**Year 1**: Faculty Common Curriculum - **Introduction to Social Sciences, Research Methods, and Academic Writing**. Students explore 2-3 potential majors before declaring at the end of Year 1. All students complete **a quantitative methods course** regardless of major.

**Years 2-3**: Major courses and faculty electives. Each major requires **72-90 credits**. Available majors: **China Studies, Geography, Journalism & Media Studies, Politics & Public Administration, Psychology, Social Policy & Social Work, Sociology, Social Data Science, and Urban Governance**.

**Year 4**: Capstone experience - **honours dissertation, applied research project, or professional portfolio**. Social Work majors complete **800 hours of supervised fieldwork**. Journalism majors produce a **final-year multimedia project**. Psychology majors conduct an **empirical research study**.

**Professional accreditation**: **Social Work major** fully accredited by the **Social Workers Registration Board (SWRB)** - graduates eligible for **Registered Social Worker (RSW)** status. **Psychology major** aligned with **Hong Kong Psychological Society (HKPS)** requirements for graduate membership.

**Experiential learning**: All majors include **practicum, internship, or fieldwork components**. Partners include **HKCSS, Oxfam Hong Kong, RTHK, Legislative Council Secretariat, and District Councils**. The **Social Sciences Internship Programme** places 200+ students annually.

**Exchange and global learning**: Partnerships with **LSE, University of Chicago, Sciences Po, National University of Singapore, and Peking University**. Faculty-specific summer field schools in **rural China, Southeast Asia, and Europe** for China Studies, Geography, and Sociology majors.

career.title: Career Pathways & Prospects
bullets: **Social services sector**: **Social Work** graduates join **HKCSS member agencies, Caritas Hong Kong, Salvation Army, and Tung Wah Group of Hospitals** as registered social workers. Starting salary: **HK$24,000-28,000/month**. Government social work officers (SWO) start at **HK$34,060/month** (Point 15).

**Government and public policy**: Graduates enter the **Hong Kong Civil Service** through the **Common Recruitment Examination (CRE)** and **Basic Law Test**. Roles in **Home Affairs Bureau, Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Bureau, Census and Statistics Department, and ICAC**. Starting salaries: **HK$22,000-34,000/month** depending on grade.

**Media and communications**: **Journalism & Media Studies** graduates join **SCMP, Ming Pao, RTHK, TVB, Now TV, and online media outlets** as reporters, producers, and digital content creators. PR and corporate communications roles at **Edelman, Ogilvy, and in-house teams** at **MTR, CLP, and Swire**.

**Market research and consulting**: **Psychology, Sociology, and Social Data Science** graduates recruited by **Nielsen, Ipsos, McKinsey, Deloitte, and local survey research firms** as analysts and consultants. Starting salaries: **HK$22,000-28,000/month**.

**Further studies**: **Master of Social Work (MSW)** for advanced practice. **Master of Journalism (MJ)** at HKU or CUHK. **MSc in Psychology (Conversion)** for clinical psychology pathway. **Master of Public Policy (MPP)** or **Master of International Relations** for policy careers. PhD for academic research.

**NGO and international organisations**: Graduates work at **UNICEF Hong Kong, Amnesty International, WWF, Red Cross, and local advocacy groups** as programme officers, campaigners, and researchers. International careers with **UN agencies, World Bank, and Asian Development Bank** after graduate study.

campus.title: Campus Life & Student Experience
bullets: **The Jockey Club Tower**: The Faculty main building houses **lecture theatres, research centres, computer labs, and the Faculty Common Room**. The **Journalism and Media Studies Centre (JMSC)** has state-of-the-art **TV studios, radio booths, and editing suites**.

**HKU Social Sciences Society**: One of the largest faculty societies, organising **Social Sciences Week**, academic forums, career fairs, and mentorship dinners. Subject societies include **Psychology Society, Sociology Society, and Journalism Society** with industry networking events.

**Research centres and institutes**: Students have access to **the Centre for Civil Society and Governance, the HKU-Pasteur Research Pole (for public health)**, and **the Centre for China Studies** - all offer **undergraduate research assistant positions** and seminar series.

**Hall and college life**: Social Sciences students are active in all **residential halls** and **St. John College**. The **Social Sciences Residential Programme** at **R.C. Lee Hall** offers themed floors for students interested in public policy and community service.

**Location**: Faculty buildings are on the **Main Campus** with easy access to **the MTR (HKU Station Exit C1)**. The **JMSC** is located at **The University of Hong Kong Shenzhen Institute of Research and Innovation (HKU-SIRI)** for some advanced media courses.

competitiveness.title: Admission Competitiveness Analysis
bullets: **Overall difficulty: ★★★☆☆ Moderately Competitive** - HKU Social Sciences is competitive but accessible. The broad major portfolio and lack of specific elective requirements attract diverse applicants.

**Median DSE score: 27 points** (Best 6). The lower quartile typically scores **25-26 points**. Upper quartile reaches **29-30 points** for competitive majors like **Journalism, Psychology, and Social Work**.

**Band A applicants vs places**: Approximately **4-5 Band A applicants per place**. Total JUPAS intake: **~350-400 students** per year across all majors. Most competitive majors: **Journalism & Media Studies, Psychology, and Social Work**.

**Non-JUPAS intake**: Around **15-20%** of places for international qualifications. IB entrants typically present **32-35 points**. A-Level candidates need **ABB-BBB**. Portfolio or writing samples may be required for Journalism applicants.

**Comparison with CUHK Social Science (JS4801)**: HKU Social Sciences has **stronger journalism and media facilities** (JMSC) and more urban internship links. CUHK Social Science is known for **stronger sociology and anthropology** research and a larger campus. Median scores are comparable (CUHK ~26-27).

**Key differentiators for successful applicants**: (1) **Strong language grades** (Chinese and English at Level 4+); (2) **Relevant extracurriculars** - debating, Model UN, volunteering, student journalism; (3) **Quantitative skills** (M1/M2 or Economics) for data-heavy majors; (4) **Social awareness** demonstrated in SLP - engagement with community issues, policy debates, or social innovation.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Faculty
bullets: **Mr. Ronny Tong Ka-wah** - Senior Counsel and former Convenor of the Path of Democracy. HKU BSSc (Economics) and LLB. Prominent figure in Hong Kong legal and political circles.
**Prof. Ng Chun-hung** - Former Head of Sociology at HKU and leading scholar in Hong Kong social movements and civil society. His research on the 2014 Umbrella Movement is widely cited.

**Ms. Claudia Mo Man-ching** - Former journalist and Legislative Council member. HKU BSSc (Journalism). Worked at BBC World Service and TVB News before entering politics. Known for her advocacy on press freedom and democratic reform.

**Mr. Shiu Sin-por** - Former Head of the Central Policy Unit (2012-2017) under the Hong Kong SAR Government. HKU BSSc (Sociology) and MPhil. Key government advisor on social policy, poverty alleviation, and housing.

**Prof. Winnie Mak Wing-sze** - Professor of Psychology at CUHK and leading researcher in health psychology and cancer survivorship. HKU BSSc (Psychology) and PhD. Her work on psycho-oncology has influenced cancer care policy across Asia.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
bullets: **HKU Foundation Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to top JUPAS entrants with **Best 6 at 32 points or above**. Covers **full tuition fees** (HK$42,100/year) plus living allowance of **HK$15,000/year**. Renewable with CGPA 3.00+.

**Faculty of Social Sciences Scholarships**: Merit-based awards for continuing students with **CGPA 3.50+**. Amounts range from **HK$8,000 to HK$20,000** per year. Over 35 awards available across all departments, funded by alumni and corporate donors.

**Journalism and Media Studies Centre Scholarship**: For Journalism majors with outstanding academic performance and portfolio work. **HK$20,000-30,000/year**. Includes mentorship from **senior editors at SCMP, RTHK, and Ming Pao**.

**Social Work Fieldwork Bursary**: Supports Social Work majors during **fieldwork placements** to cover transport and incidental expenses. **HK$10,000-15,000/year** depending on placement location. Priority for placements in **remote districts** (Islands, North District).

**HKU Bursaries and Financial Aid**: Need-based support through **SFAA** and HKU bursary fund. Covers tuition, hall fees, and living expenses. **Social Sciences-specific emergency grants** available for students facing hardship during fieldwork or internships.

tips.title: Ace Sir Social Sciences Strategy
bullets: **Ace Sir says: Social Sciences is the hidden gem of HKU.** At 27 points median, it is more accessible than Arts (28) but offers **equally strong career prospects** - especially in government, social services, and media. Do not overlook it because it sounds soft.

**Subject combination strategy**: No required electives, but **Economics or M1/M2** opens doors to **Economics, Social Data Science, and Psychology** majors. For **Journalism**, any combination works but strong English is essential. For **Social Work**, Biology or Combined Science helps with human development courses.

**Band A positioning**: Put JS6717 in **Band A if your Best 6 is 25+ with balanced grades**. If your score is 23-24, it is a **reach** - but Social Sciences has a wider intake range. Have CUHK Social Science (JS4801) or HKBU Social Work in Band B.

**Demonstrate social awareness**: Unlike Medicine or Law, Social Sciences values **engagement with real-world issues**. Mention volunteering with NGOs, participating in policy debates, writing for student newspapers, or conducting community surveys. Show you care about how society works.

**Quantitative skills matter more than you think**: Even non-Economics majors require statistics and research methods. If you have **M1/M2 or Economics**, highlight it. If not, consider taking online courses in Excel, SPSS, or Python before Year 1 - it will give you a significant advantage.

admission.title: 入學資格與收生要求（DSE）
bullets: 最低 DSE 要求：**最佳六科達 27 分**（中位數入學成績）。社會科學學院錄取範圍廣泛；成功入學者通常考獲 **25-29 分**
核心科目最低要求：**中國語文及英國語文達第 3 級**；**數學（必修部分）及通識教育**（或公民與社會發展）達第 2 級。**英國語文達第 4 級以上強烈偏好**，適用於新聞學、國際關係及社會工作等主修
選修科要求：**無特定選修科要求**。學院歡迎各種選科組合。但**經濟學、歷史或地理**對相關主修可能有幫助。M1/M2 數學對經濟學、心理學（統計學）及社會數據科學有幫助
標準 JUPAS 入學**不設面試**。篩選基於學業成績及 OEA/SLP。非 JUPAS 申請人或獲邀參加面試（競爭激烈主修如新聞學、社會工作、心理學）
科目比重：**中國語文及英國語文於入學分數計算中獲 1.5 倍比重**。數學及通識教育按標準比重計算。任何科目考獲 5** 可獲額外加分

curriculum.title: 課程結構與內容
bullets: **四年全日制課程**（240 學分）。學生從 **9 個學系**中選擇**主修**，並可於社會科學學院或其他學院加修**輔修**。經批准可修讀**雙主修**
**第一年**：學院共同課程——**社會科學導論、研究方法及學術寫作**。學生於第一年結束前探索 2-3 個潛在主修。所有學生不論主修均須完成**量化方法課程**
**第二至三年**：主修課程及學院選修科。每個主修須修讀 **72-90 學分**。可選主修：**中國研究、地理學、新聞與傳媒研究、政治與公共行政、心理學、社會政策與社會工作、社會學、社會數據科學及城市管治**
**第四年**：畢業專題體驗——**榮譽學位論文、應用研究項目或專業作品集**。社會工作主修須完成 **800 小時督導實地考察**。新聞學主修須製作**畢業年多媒體項目**。心理學主修須進行**實證研究**
**專業認可**：**社會工作主修**獲**社會工作者註冊局（SWRB）**全面認可——畢業生符合資格申請**註冊社會工作者（RSW）**資格。**心理學主修**與**香港心理學會（HKPS）**的研究生會員要求接軌
**體驗式學習**：所有主修均包括**實習、實習或實地考察部分**。合作夥伴包括**香港社會服務聯會、樂施會香港、香港電台、立法會秘書處及區議會**。社會科學實習計劃每年安排超過 200 名學生
**交流及全球學習**：與**倫敦政治經濟學院、芝加哥大學、巴黎政治學院、新加坡國立大學及北京大學**合作。學院專屬暑期田野學校設於**中國農村、東南亞及歐洲**，供中國研究、地理學及社會學主修生參加

career.title: 職業出路與前景
bullets: **社會服務界別**：**社會工作**畢業生加入**香港社會服務聯會會員機構、明愛香港、救世軍及東華三院**擔任註冊社會工作者。起薪點：**每月 24,000-28,000 港元**。政府社會工作主任（SWO）起薪點為**每月 34,060 港元**（第 15 點）
**政府及公共政策**：畢業生透過**綜合招聘考試（CRE）**及**基本法測試**進入**香港公務員隊伍**。**民政事務局、政制及內地事務局、政府統計處及廉政公署**等職位重視良好的語言及分析能力。起薪點：**每月 22,000-34,000 港元**（視職級而定）
**傳媒及通訊**：**新聞與傳媒研究**畢業生加入**南華早報、明報、香港電台、無綫電視、Now TV 及網上媒體**擔任記者、製作人及數碼內容創作者。公關及企業傳訊職位包括**愛德曼、奧美及港鐵、中電、太古等企業內部團隊**
**市場研究及顧問**：**心理學、社會學及社會數據科學**畢業生獲**尼爾森、益普索、麥肯錫、德勤及本地調查研究公司**聘用為分析師及顧問。起薪點：**每月 22,000-28,000 港元**
**進修途徑**：修讀**社會工作碩士（MSW）**以進階實務。於港大或中大修讀**新聞學碩士（MJ）**。修讀**心理學理學碩士（轉制課程）**以進入臨床心理學途徑。修讀**公共政策碩士（MPP）**或**國際關係碩士**以從事政策事業。攻讀博士學位從事學術研究
**非政府組織及國際機構**：畢業生於**聯合國兒童基金會香港分會、國際特赦組織、世界自然基金會、紅十字會及本地倡導團體**擔任項目主任、運動倡議者及研究員。進修後可於**聯合國機構、世界銀行及亞洲開發銀行**從事國際事業

campus.title: 校園生活與學生體驗
bullets: **賽馬會教學樓**：學院主樓設有**演講廳、研究中心、電腦室及學院公共休息室**。**新聞及傳媒研究中心（JMSC）**配備最先進的**電視錄影廠、電台直播室及剪接室**
**港大社會科學學會**：最大的學院學會之一，每年舉辦**社會科學周**、學術論壇、就業博覽及導師晚宴。學科學會包括**心理學會、社會學會及新聞學會**，定期舉辦業界交流活動
**研究中心及學院**：學生可使用**公民社會及管治研究中心、港大巴斯德研究中心（公共衞生）**及**中國研究中心**——全部提供**本科生研究助理職位**及研討會系列
**舍堂及書院生活**：社會科學學生活躍於全部**住宿舍堂**及**聖約翰書院**。**利希慎堂的社會科學住宿計劃**為對公共政策及社區服務有興趣的學生提供主題樓層
**地理位置**：學院大樓位於**本部校園**，毗鄰**港鐵香港大學站 C1 出口**。**新聞及傳媒研究中心（JMSC）**設於**港大深圳研究院（HKU-SIRI）**，提供部分高階媒體課程

competitiveness.title: 入學競爭力分析
bullets: **整體難度：★★★☆☆ 中等競爭**——港大社會科學具競爭力但門檻合理。廣泛的主修選擇及無特定選修科要求吸引多元背景的申請人
**中位數 DSE 成績：27 分**（最佳六科）。下四分位數通常考獲 **25-26 分**。上四分位數達 **29-30 分**（競爭激烈主修如新聞學、心理學及社會工作）
**Band A 申請人與學額比例**：每個學額約有 **4-5 個 Band A 申請人**。JUPAS 總收生額：每年約 **350-400 人**（涵蓋所有主修）。競爭最激烈的主修：**新聞與傳媒研究、心理學及社會工作**
**非 JUPAS 入學比例**：約 **15-20%** 學額保留予國際學歷申請人。IB 入學者通常考獲 **32-35 分**。A-Level 考生需考獲 **ABB-BBB**。新聞學申請人或須提交作品集或寫作樣本
**與中大社會科學（JS4801）比較**：港大社會科學擁有**更強的新聞及媒體設施**（JMSC）及更多市區實習聯繫。中大社會科學以**更強的社會學及人類學**研究實力及更大的校園聞名。中位數成績相若（中大約 26-27 分）
**成功申請人的關鍵優勢**：(1) **優異的語文成績**（中英文達第 4 級以上）；(2) **相關課外活動**——辯論、模擬聯合國、義工服務、學生記者；(3) **量化能力**（M1/M2 或經濟學）對數據密集型主修有幫助；(4) 於 SLP 中展現**社會意識**——參與社區議題、政策辯論或社會創新

scholarships.title: 獎學金與經濟援助
bullets: HKU Foundation Entrance Scholarship: Best 6 at 32+ points. Full tuition plus HK5,000/year living allowance.
Faculty of Social Sciences Scholarships: CGPA 3.50+. HK,000-20,000/year. Over 35 awards available.
Journalism and Media Studies Centre Scholarship: HK0,000-30,000/year for Journalism majors.
Social Work Fieldwork Bursary: HK0,000-15,000/year for fieldwork transport and expenses.

tips.title: Ace Sir Social Sciences Strategy
bullets: Ace Sir says: Social Sciences is the hidden gem of HKU. At 27 points median, more accessible than Arts (28) but equally strong career prospects.
Subject combination: No required electives, but Economics or M1/M2 opens doors to Economics, Social Data Science, and Psychology majors.
Band A positioning: Put JS6717 in Band A if Best 6 is 25+ with balanced grades. Have CUHK Social Science in Band B.
Demonstrate social awareness: Mention volunteering with NGOs, policy debates, student newspapers, or community surveys.
Quantitative skills matter: Even non-Economics majors require statistics. Highlight M1/M2 or Economics if you have them.
